items.description: Kitchen air conditioning unit - replacement including installation and delivery (3 pcs)
items.rationale: The insured peril is overvoltage caused by lightning (2.3.3), which is covered for insured electrical installations. The fixed kitchen AC unit is a technical installation firmly connected to the building (4.2.3) and is not excluded by the general exclusions. However, 2.3.10(c) specifically excludes overvoltage cover for climate-control equipment installed within five metres of a cooking appliance (hob), regardless of the cause or evidence. The photo and description confirm the AC unit is close to the hob, so this exclusion applies. The entire combined line (replacement unit, installation, delivery) is therefore not indemnified (3.5(a), 3.5(e), 7.1.11). Reference cases 19 and 17 confirm that surge-damaged electronics are only covered if not excluded by a specific clause.
